description.excerpt: HTMX 4 is a full rewrite of HTMX and therefore has a number of breaking changes: fetch() replaces XMLHttpRequest Explicit inheritance Error responses swap hx-delete excludes form data No history cache OOB swap order hx-trigger queue modifier removed 60-second timeout Extension loading A guide to these changes is provided at htmx.org. Modules that have custom JavaScript which uses the htmx API should review that migration guide.
